hebrew_line: תָּנ֣וּס לְפָנָ֑יו וְהָיִ֣יתָ לְזַעֲוָ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
kjv_line: and flee before them: and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her:
thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof.

hebrew_line: הַגֵּר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּקִרְבְּךָ֔ יַעֲלֶ֥ה עָלֶ֖יךָ מַ֣עְלָה מָּ֑עְלָה וְאַתָּ֥ה תֵרֵ֖ד
kjv_line: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down

hebrew_line: וּבָ֨אוּ עָלֶ֜יךָ כָּל־הַקְּלָל֣וֹת הָאֵ֗לֶּה וּרְדָפ֙וּךָ֙ וְהִשִּׂיג֔וּךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּֽׁמְדָ֑ךְ
kjv_line: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed;

hebrew_line: וְהָיָ֡ה בְּשָׁמְעוֹ֩ אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֨י הָֽאָלָ֜ה הַזֹּ֗את וְהִתְבָּרֵ֨ךְ בִּלְבָב֤וֹ לֵאמֹר֙
kjv_line: And it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying,
and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.

hebrew_line: לֵאמֹ֗ר מִ֣י יַעֲלֶה־לָּ֤נוּ הַשָּׁמַ֙יְמָה֙ וְיִקָּחֶ֣הָ לָּ֔נוּ
kjv_line: that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us,

hebrew_line: לֵאמֹ֗ר מִ֣י יַעֲבָר־לָ֜נוּ אֶל־עֵ֤בֶר הַיָּם֙ וְיִקָּחֶ֣הָ לָּ֔נוּ
kjv_line: that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us,

hebrew_line: וּנְתָנָ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם לָהֶ֔ם כְּכָל־הַמִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶתְכֶֽם׃
kjv_line: And the LORD shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.

hebrew_line: וַֽיהוָ֞ה ה֣וּא׀ הַהֹלֵ֣ךְ לְפָנֶ֗יךָ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א יַרְפְּךָ֖
kjv_line: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee,
fear not, neither be dismayed.

hebrew_line: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה הִנְּךָ֥ שֹׁכֵ֖ב עִם־אֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ
kjv_line: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers;

hebrew_line: וְקָם֩ הָעָ֨ם הַזֶּ֜ה וְזָנָ֣ה׀ אַחֲרֵ֣י׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י נֵֽכַר־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר ה֤וּא בָא־שָׁ֙מָּה֙ בְּקִרְבּ֔וֹ
kjv_line: and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go to be among them,
and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them,
then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them,

hebrew_line: וְשַׂמְתֶּ֣ם אֹת֔וֹ מִצַּ֛ד אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָֽיָה־שָׁ֥ם בְּךָ֖ לְעֵֽד׃
kjv_line: and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.
and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him,
As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young,
spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them,
I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.
I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:

hebrew_line: ל֥וּ חָכְמ֖וּ יַשְׂכִּ֣ילוּ זֹ֑את יָבִ֖ינוּ לְאַחֲרִיתָֽם׃
kjv_line: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!

hebrew_line: כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיִ֤יתִי עִם־מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א אַרְפְּךָ֖
kjv_line: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee,
Only be thou strong and very courageous,

hebrew_line: לֹֽא־יָמ֡וּשׁ סֵפֶר֩ הַתּוֹרָ֨ה הַזֶּ֜ה מִפִּ֗יךָ וְהָגִ֤יתָ בּוֹ֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה
kjv_line: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night,
Pass through the host, and command the people,
then ye shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy it,

hebrew_line: וַֽיַּעֲנ֔וּ אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּיתָ֙נוּ֙ נַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה
kjv_line: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that thou commandest us we will do,
only be strong and of a good courage.

hebrew_line: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם גַּם־אַתֶּ֜ם עִם־בֵּ֤ית אָבִי֙ חֶ֔סֶד וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם לִ֖י א֥וֹת אֱמֶֽת׃
kjv_line: that ye will also shew kindness unto my father's house, and give me a true token:

hebrew_line: הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה אָחֵל֙ גַּדֶּלְךָ֔ בְּעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר֙ יֵֽדְע֔וּן כִּ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיִ֛יתִי עִם־מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶהְיֶ֥ה עִמָּֽךְ׃
kjv_line: This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee.

hebrew_line: גֹּ֣שׁוּ הֵ֔נָּה וְשִׁמְע֕וּ אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶֽם׃
kjv_line: Come hither, and hear the words of the LORD your God.

hebrew_line: וְצַוּ֣וּ אוֹתָם֮ לֵאמֹר֒ שְׂאֽוּ־לָכֶ֨ם מִזֶּ֜ה מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן מִמַּצַּב֙ רַגְלֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים הָכִ֖ין
kjv_line: And command ye them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan, out of the place where the priests' feet stood firm,

hebrew_line: וְנָ֨פְלָ֜ה חוֹמַ֤ת הָעִיר֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔יהָ וְעָל֥וּ הָעָ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ נֶגְדּֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.

hebrew_line: וַיְהִ֗י כֶּאֱמֹ֣ר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֮ אֶל־הָעָם֒ וְשִׁבְעָ֣ה הַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹשְׂאִים֩ שִׁבְעָ֨ה שׁוֹפְר֤וֹת הַיּֽוֹבְלִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עָבְר֕וּ וְתָקְע֖וּ
kjv_line: And it came to pass, when Joshua had spoken unto the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams' horns passed on before the LORD, and blew with
And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about

kjv_line: when ye take of the accursed thing, and make the camp of Israel a curse,

hebrew_line: וַיְהִי֩ כִשְׁמֹ֨עַ הָעָ֜ם אֶת־ק֣וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָ֗ר וַיָּרִ֤יעוּ הָעָם֙ תְּרוּעָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה
kjv_line: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout,

hebrew_line: וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ אֲנָשִׁ֜ים מִֽירִיח֗וֹ הָעַ֞י אֲשֶׁ֨ר עִם־בֵּ֥ית אָ֙וֶן֙ מִקֶּ֣דֶם לְבֵֽית־אֵ֔ל
kjv_line: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth-aven, on the east side of Beth-el,

hebrew_line: וְיַכּ֣וּ אֶת־הָעָ֑י אַל־תְּיַגַּע־שָׁ֙מָּה֙ אֶת־כָּל־הָעָ֔ם כִּ֥י מְעַ֖ט הֵֽמָּה׃
kjv_line: and smite Ai; and make not all the people to labour thither; for they are but few.
and shall environ us round, and cut off our name from the earth:

hebrew_line: לֹ֤א אוֹסִיף֙ לִֽהְי֣וֹת עִמָּכֶ֔ם אִם־לֹ֥א תַשְׁמִ֛ידוּ הַחֵ֖רֶם מִֽקִּרְבְּכֶֽם׃
kjv_line: neither will I be with you any more, except ye destroy the accursed from among you.

hebrew_line: וְהַגֶּד־נָ֥א לִי֙ מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֔יתָ אַל־תְּכַחֵ֖ד מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
kjv_line: and tell me now what thou hast done; hide it not from me.

hebrew_line: תָּבֹ֣זּוּ לָכֶ֑ם שִׂים־לְךָ֥ אֹרֵ֛ב לָעִ֖יר מֵאַחֲרֶֽיהָ׃
kjv_line: thereof, shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves: lay thee an ambush for the city behind it.

hebrew_line: וַיְצַ֨ו אֹתָ֜ם לֵאמֹ֗ר רְ֠אוּ אַתֶּ֞ם אֹרְבִ֤ים לָעִיר֙ מֵאַחֲרֵ֣י הָעִ֔יר
kjv_line: And he commanded them, saying, Behold, ye shall lie in wait against the city, even behind the city: go

hebrew_line: אַל־תַּרְחִ֥יקוּ מִן־הָעִ֖יר מְאֹ֑ד וִהְיִיתֶ֥ם כֻּלְּכֶ֖ם נְכֹנִֽים׃
kjv_line: not very far from the city, but be ye all ready:
and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us, as at the first,

kjv_line: And it shall be, when ye have taken the city, that ye shall set the city on fire:

hebrew_line: כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ רְא֖וּ צִוִּ֥יתִי אֶתְכֶֽם׃
kjv_line: according to the commandment of the LORD shall ye do. See, I have commanded you.

hebrew_line: וַיְהִ֞י כִּרְא֣וֹת מֶֽלֶךְ־הָעַ֗י וַֽיְמַהֲר֡וּ וַיַּשְׁכִּ֡ימוּ וַיֵּצְא֣וּ אַנְשֵֽׁי־הָעִ֣יר לִקְרַֽאת־יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל לַֽמִּלְחָמָ֞ה ה֧וּא
kjv_line: And it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw it, that they hasted and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle,

hebrew_line: וַיְהִ֣י כְּכַלּ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל לַהֲרֹג֩ אֶת־כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֨י הָעַ֜י בַּשָּׂדֶ֗ה בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רְדָפ֣וּם בּ֔וֹ וַֽיִּפְּל֥וּ כֻלָּ֛ם לְפִי־חֶ֖רֶב עַד־תֻּמָּ֑ם
kjv_line: And it came to pass, when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed,

hebrew_line: וַיְהִי֩ כִשְׁמֹ֨עַ אֲדֹֽנִי־צֶ֜דֶק מֶ֣לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם כִּֽי־לָכַ֨ד יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ אֶת־הָעַי֮ וַיַּחֲרִימָהּ֒
kjv_line: Now it came to pass, when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it;

hebrew_line: וְעִזְרֻ֔נִי וְנַכֶּ֖ה אֶת־גִּבְע֑וֹן כִּֽי־הִשְׁלִ֥ימָה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ וְאֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
kjv_line: and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.

hebrew_line: וַיֵּאָסְפ֨וּ וַֽיַּעֲל֜וּ חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת׀ מַלְכֵ֣י הָאֱמֹרִ֗י מֶ֣לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם מֶֽלֶךְ־חֶבְר֤וֹן מֶֽלֶךְ־יַרְמוּת֙ מֶֽלֶךְ־לָכִ֣ישׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־עֶגְל֔וֹן הֵ֖ם
kjv_line: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up,
and save us, and help us:

hebrew_line: וַיְהִ֞י בְּנֻסָ֣ם׀ מִפְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הֵ֞ם בְּמוֹרַ֤ד בֵּית־חוֹרֹן֙ וַֽיהוָ֡ה הִשְׁלִ֣יךְ עֲלֵיהֶם֩ אֲבָנִ֨ים גְּדֹל֧וֹת מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם עַד־עֲזֵקָ֖ה
kjv_line: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Israel, and were in the going down to Beth-horon, that the LORD cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah,
and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them

hebrew_line: וַיְהִי֩ כְּכַלּ֨וֹת יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לְהַכּוֹתָ֛ם מַכָּ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה־מְאֹ֖ד עַד־תֻּמָּ֑ם וְהַשְּׂרִידִים֙ שָׂרְד֣וּ מֵהֶ֔ם וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל־עָרֵ֥י הַמִּבְצָֽר׃
kjv_line: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities.

hebrew_line: וַ֠יְהִי כְּֽהוֹצִיאָ֞ם אֶת־הַמְּלָכִ֣ים הָאֵלֶּה֮ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֒ וַיִּקְרָ֨א יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל־כָּל־אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל
kjv_line: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel,

hebrew_line: וַיְהִ֕י כִּשְׁמֹ֖עַ יָבִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ־חָצ֑וֹר וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֶל־יוֹבָב֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מָד֔וֹן
kjv_line: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon,
they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom,

hebrew_line: וַיְהִ֣י בְּבוֹאָ֗הּ וַתְּסִיתֵ֙הוּ֙ לִשְׁא֤וֹל מֵֽאֵת־אָבִ֙יהָ֙ שָׂדֶ֔ה
kjv_line: And it came to pass, as she came unto him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field:
And goeth out from Beth-el to Luz,
and the border went about eastward unto Taanath-shiloh,
and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.

hebrew_line: וַֽהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם אֵלַ֖י הֵ֑נָּה וְיָרִ֨יתִי לָכֶ֤ם גּוֹרָל֙ פֹּ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
kjv_line: and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.
and describe it, and come again

kjv_line: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,
So she caught him, and kissed him,
Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.

hebrew_line: בִּ֭י מְלָכִ֣ים יִמְלֹ֑כוּ וְ֝רוֹזְנִ֗ים יְחֹ֣קְקוּ צֶֽדֶק׃
kjv_line: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

hebrew_line: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִ֑י וְ֝אַשְׁרֵ֗י דְּרָכַ֥י יִשְׁמֹֽרוּ׃
kjv_line: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.
Hear instruction, and be wise,
Forsake the foolish, and live;
Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser:

hebrew_line: מִי־פֶ֭תִי יָסֻ֣ר הֵ֑נָּה וַחֲסַר־לֵ֝֗ב וְאָ֣מְרָה לּֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,

hebrew_line: שִׂפְתֵ֣י צַ֭דִּיק יִרְע֣וּ רַבִּ֑ים וֶֽ֝אֱוִילִ֗ים בַּחֲסַר־לֵ֥ב יָמֽוּתוּ׃
kjv_line: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.

hebrew_line: הֵ֣ן צַ֭דִּיק בָּאָ֣רֶץ יְשֻׁלָּ֑ם אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־רָשָׁ֥ע וְחוֹטֵֽא׃
kjv_line: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness:
man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.

hebrew_line: בֵּ֣ית רְ֭שָׁעִים יִשָּׁמֵ֑ד וְאֹ֖הֶל יְשָׁרִ֣ים יַפְרִֽיחַ׃
kjv_line: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

hebrew_line: בֵּ֣ית גֵּ֭אִים יִסַּ֥ח׀ יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝יַצֵּ֗ב גְּב֣וּל אַלְמָנָֽה׃
kjv_line: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.

hebrew_line: שִׂפְתֵ֣י כְ֭סִיל יָבֹ֣אֽוּ בְרִ֑יב וּ֝פִ֗יו לְֽמַהֲלֻמ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽא׃
kjv_line: A fool's lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.

hebrew_line: מִגְדַּל־עֹ֭ז שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה בּֽוֹ־יָר֖וּץ צַדִּ֣יק וְנִשְׂגָּֽב׃
kjv_line: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.

hebrew_line: ה֗וֹן יֹ֭סִיף רֵעִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝דָ֗ל מֵרֵ֥עהוּ יִפָּרֵֽד׃
kjv_line: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
and he that speaketh lies shall perish.
Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware:

hebrew_line: מֵ֭חֹרֶף עָצֵ֣ל לֹא־יַחֲרֹ֑שׁ וְשָׁאַ֖ל בַּקָּצִ֣יר וָאָֽיִן׃
kjv_line: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.
Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out;
Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.

hebrew_line: אַ֭תָּה בַּשֵּׁ֣בֶט תַּכֶּ֑נּוּ וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ מִשְּׁא֥וֹל תַּצִּֽיל׃
kjv_line: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.
Hear thou, my son, and be wise,

hebrew_line: אַף־הִ֭יא כְּחֶ֣תֶף תֶּֽאֱרֹ֑ב וּ֝בוֹגְדִ֗ים בְּאָדָ֥ם תּוֹסִֽף׃
kjv_line: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.

hebrew_line: הֵן֮ לֹא־יָדַ֪עְנ֫וּ זֶ֥ה הֲֽלֹא־תֹ֘כֵ֤ן לִבּ֨וֹת׀ הֽוּא־יָבִ֗ין
kjv_line: Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it?

hebrew_line: אַל־תֶּאֱרֹ֣ב רָ֭שָׁע לִנְוֵ֣ה צַדִּ֑יק אַֽל־תְּשַׁדֵּ֥ד רִבְצוֹ׃
kjv_line: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:
Fret not thyself because of evil men, neither be thou envious at the wicked;
My son, fear thou the LORD and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:
But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.

hebrew_line: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָֽשָׂה־לִ֭י כֵּ֤ן אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־לּ֑וֹ אָשִׁ֖יב לָאִ֣ישׁ כְּפָעֳלֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.
Then I saw, and considered it well:

hebrew_line: אַל־תֵּצֵ֥א לָרִ֗ב מַ֫הֵ֥ר פֶּ֣ן מַה־תַּ֭עֲשֶׂה בְּאַחֲרִיתָ֑הּ
kjv_line: Go not forth hastily to strive, lest thou know not what to do in the end
Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest
he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.
and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.
doth sing and rejoice.

hebrew_line: כָּל־ר֭וּחוֹ יוֹצִ֣יא כְסִ֑יל וְ֝חָכָ֗ם בְּאָח֥וֹר יְשַׁבְּחֶֽנָּה׃
kjv_line: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.

hebrew_line: בִּרְב֣וֹת רְ֭שָׁעִים יִרְבֶּה־פָּ֑שַׁע וְ֝צַדִּיקִ֗ים בְּֽמַפַּלְתָּ֥ם יִרְאֽוּ׃
kjv_line: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.
Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest;

hebrew_line: שָׁ֤וְא׀ וּֽדְבַר־כָּזָ֡ב הַרְחֵ֬ק מִמֶּ֗נִּי רֵ֣אשׁ וָ֭עֹשֶׁר אַל־תִּֽתֶּן־לִ֑י
kjv_line: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches;
The eye that mocketh at his father, and despiseth to obey his mother,
Open thy mouth, judge righteously,

hebrew_line: אָמַ֤רְתִּֽי אֲנִי֙ בְּלִבִּ֔י לְכָה־נָּ֛א אֲנַסְּכָ֛ה בְשִׂמְחָ֖ה
kjv_line: I said in mine heart, Go to now, I will prove thee with mirth,
When thou vowest a vow unto God, defer

hebrew_line: גַּ֥ם כָּל־יָמָ֖יו בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ יֹאכֵ֑ל וְכָעַ֥ס הַרְבֵּ֖ה
kjv_line: All his days also he eateth in darkness, and he hath much sorrow

hebrew_line: וְלֹֽא־יַשְׁלִיטֶ֤נּוּ הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ לֶאֱכֹ֣ל מִמֶּ֔נּוּ כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ נָכְרִ֖י יֹֽאכֲלֶ֑נּוּ
kjv_line: yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof, but a stranger eateth it:
which he spendeth as a shadow? for who can tell a man
Be not over much wicked, neither be thou foolish:

hebrew_line: אַל־תִּבָּהֵ֤ל מִפָּנָיו֙ תֵּלֵ֔ךְ אַֽל־תַּעֲמֹ֖ד בְּדָבָ֣ר רָ֑ע
kjv_line: Be not hasty to go out of his sight: stand not in an evil thing;
and who may say unto him, What doest thou?
yet he shall not find it; yea further; though a wise man think

hebrew_line: זְב֣וּבֵי מָ֔וֶת יַבְאִ֥ישׁ יַבִּ֖יעַ שֶׁ֣מֶן רוֹקֵ֑חַ
kjv_line: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour:

hebrew_line: כִּ֚י לֹ֣א תֵדַ֔ע מַה־יִּהְיֶ֥ה רָעָ֖ה עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
kjv_line: for thou knowest not what evil shall be upon the earth.

hebrew_line: שְׂמַ֧ח בָּח֣וּר בְּיַלְדוּתֶ֗יךָ וִֽיטִֽיבְךָ֤ לִבְּךָ֙ בִּימֵ֣י בְחוּרוֹתֶ֔ךָ
kjv_line: Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth; and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth,

hebrew_line: וְהָסֵ֥ר כַּ֙עַס֙ מִלִּבֶּ֔ךָ וְהַעֲבֵ֥ר רָעָ֖ה מִבְּשָׂרֶ֑ךָ כִּֽי־הַיַּלְד֥וּת וְהַֽשַּׁחֲר֖וּת הָֽבֶל׃
kjv_line: Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart, and put away evil from thy flesh: for childhood and youth are vanity.

hebrew_line: וְהִגִּ֣יעוּ שָׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֹּאמַ֔ר אֵֽין־לִ֥י בָהֶ֖ם חֵֽפֶץ׃
kjv_line: not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;
and the almond tree shall flourish, and the grasshopper shall be a burden,

hebrew_line: אֶת־הָאֱלֹהִ֤ים יְרָא֙ וְאֶת־מִצְוֹתָ֣יו שְׁמ֔וֹר כִּי־זֶ֖ה כָּל־הָאָדָֽם׃
kjv_line: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.

hebrew_line: הֱבִיאַ֨נִי הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ חֲדָרָ֗יו נָגִ֤ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה֙ בָּ֔ךְ
kjv_line: the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad and rejoice in thee,
go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, and feed thy kids
I will rise now, and go about the city in the streets,
I said, I will go up to the palm tree, I will take hold of the boughs thereof:
I would kiss thee; yea, I should not be despised.
I would lead thee, and bring thee into my mother's house,
what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?

hebrew_line: עַ֣ל מֶ֥ה תֻכּ֛וּ ע֖וֹד תּוֹסִ֣יפוּ סָרָ֑ה כָּל־רֹ֣אשׁ לָחֳלִ֔י
kjv_line: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick,

hebrew_line: וּבְפָרִשְׂכֶ֣ם כַּפֵּיכֶ֗ם אַעְלִ֤ים עֵינַי֙ מִכֶּ֔ם גַּ֛ם כִּֽי־תַרְבּ֥וּ תְפִלָּ֖ה
kjv_line: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you: yea, when ye make many prayers,
seek judgment, relieve the oppressed,
Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies:
and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:
And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.

hebrew_line: מַה־לָּכֶם֙ תְּדַכְּא֣וּ עַמִּ֔י וּפְנֵ֥י עֲנִיִּ֖ים תִּטְחָ֑נוּ
kjv_line: What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith
it shall not be pruned, nor digged;

hebrew_line: שֵׁכָ֣ר יִרְדֹּ֑פוּ מְאַחֲרֵ֣י בַנֶּ֔שֶׁף יַ֖יִן יַדְלִיקֵֽם׃
kjv_line: that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame them!

hebrew_line: וְתִקְרַ֣ב וְתָב֗וֹאָה עֲצַ֛ת קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְנֵדָֽעָה׃
kjv_line: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it!

hebrew_line: וְשָׁ֥רַק ל֖וֹ מִקְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהִנֵּ֥ה מְהֵרָ֖ה קַ֥ל יָבֽוֹא׃
kjv_line: and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:
and see ye indeed, but perceive not.
Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy,
and understand with their heart, and convert,
Let us go up against Judah, and vex it,

hebrew_line: וְנַבְקִעֶ֖נָּה אֵלֵ֑ינוּ וְנַמְלִ֥יךְ מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ אֵ֖ת בֶּן־טָֽבְאַֽל׃
kjv_line: and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeal:

hebrew_line: הִנֵּ֣ה הָעַלְמָ֗ה הָרָה֙ וְיֹלֶ֣דֶת בֵּ֔ן וְקָרָ֥את שְׁמ֖וֹ
kjv_line: Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name

hebrew_line: לֹֽא־תָב֣וֹא שָׁ֔מָּה יִרְאַ֖ת שָׁמִ֣יר וָשָׁ֑יִת וְהָיָה֙ לְמִשְׁלַ֣ח שׁ֔וֹר
kjv_line: there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen,
And he shall pass through Judah; he shall overflow and go over, even to the neck;
Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought;
Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.

hebrew_line: וְחִכִּ֙יתִי֙ לַיהוָ֔ה הַמַּסְתִּ֥יר פָּנָ֖יו מִבֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְקִוֵּ֖יתִֽי־לֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: And I will wait upon the LORD, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

hebrew_line: עַל־כֵּ֨ן עַל־בַּחוּרָ֜יו לֹֽא־יִשְׂמַ֣ח׀ אֲדֹנָ֗י וְאֶת־יְתֹמָ֤יו וְאֶת־אַלְמְנֹתָיו֙ לֹ֣א יְרַחֵ֔ם
kjv_line: Therefore the Lord shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows:
And he shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry;

hebrew_line: בְּג֤וֹי חָנֵף֙ אֲשַׁלְּחֶ֔נּוּ וְעַל־עַ֥ם עֶבְרָתִ֖י אֲצַוֶּ֑נּוּ
kjv_line: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge,

hebrew_line: לָ֠כֵן יְשַׁלַּ֨ח הָאָד֜וֹן יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת בְּמִשְׁמַנָּ֖יו רָז֑וֹן וְתַ֧חַת כְּבֹד֛וֹ יֵקַ֥ד יְקֹ֖ד כִּיק֥וֹד אֵֽשׁ׃
kjv_line: Therefore shall the Lord, the Lord of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.

hebrew_line: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא לֹֽא־יוֹסִ֨יף ע֜וֹד שְׁאָ֤ר יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וּפְלֵיטַ֣ת בֵּֽית־יַעֲקֹ֔ב
kjv_line: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Israel, and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again

hebrew_line: אַל־תִּירָ֥א עַמִּ֛י יֹשֵׁ֥ב צִיּ֖וֹן מֵֽאַשּׁ֑וּר בַּשֵּׁ֣בֶט יַכֶּ֔כָּה
kjv_line: O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite thee with a rod,

hebrew_line: וְהוֹכִ֥יחַ בְּמִישׁ֖וֹר לְעַנְוֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְהִֽכָּה־אֶ֙רֶץ֙ בְּשֵׁ֣בֶט פִּ֔יו
kjv_line: and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth,
their young ones shall lie down and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.

hebrew_line: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יוֹסִ֨יף אֲדֹנָ֤י׀ שֵׁנִית֙ יָד֔וֹ
kjv_line: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time
shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah,
declare his doings among the people, make mention

hebrew_line: עַ֤ל הַר־נִשְׁפֶּה֙ שְֽׂאוּ־נֵ֔ס הָרִ֥ימוּ ק֖וֹל לָהֶ֑ם
kjv_line: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them,
shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

hebrew_line: עַל־כֵּן֙ שָׁמַ֣יִם אַרְגִּ֔יז וְתִרְעַ֥שׁ הָאָ֖רֶץ מִמְּקוֹמָ֑הּ בְּעֶבְרַת֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת
kjv_line: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the LORD of hosts,

hebrew_line: וּפְרִי־בֶ֙טֶן֙ לֹ֣א יְרַחֵ֔מוּ עַל־בָּנִ֖ים לֹֽא־תָח֥וּס עֵינָֽם׃

hebrew_line: וַיָּ֤חֶל יוֹנָה֙ לָב֣וֹא בָעִ֔יר מַהֲלַ֖ךְ י֣וֹם אֶחָ֑ד וַיִּקְרָא֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר ע֚וֹד אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְנִֽינְוֵ֖ה נֶהְפָּֽכֶת׃
